evals.prompt: grill me on my plan to build a real-time collaborative document editor
evals.expected_output: The model should start asking probing questions one at a time about the plan, covering architecture decisions (conflict resolution strategy, OT vs CRDT), user model, data persistence, edge cases, and performance. Each question should include a recommended answer. The model should not dump all questions at once.

evals.prompt: I want to stress-test my design for a payment processing system. Can you interview me?
evals.expected_output: The model should recognize the trigger and begin a structured interview covering payment flow, idempotency, failure handling, reconciliation, compliance, and security. Questions should be asked one at a time with recommendations provided.

evals.prompt: Here's my plan for migrating our monolith to microservices. I need someone to challenge my assumptions.
evals.expected_output: The model should probe the migration strategy, service boundaries, data consistency approach, deployment strategy, observability, team structure alignment, and rollback plan. Each question should resolve a specific branch of the decision tree before moving to the next.
